current_role: U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security (since March 2026)
summary: Markwayne Mullin, a plumbing-business owner and former mixed martial arts fighter, represented Oklahoma in the House from 2013 to 2023 and in the Senate from 2023, where he became a close Trump ally. After Trump fired Kristi Noem in March 2026, the Senate confirmed Mullin as homeland security secretary 54–45 on March 23, 2026, during a DHS funding standoff.
